title_en: LOWE'S Profesyonel Body Firming Gel 250 ml
ingredients_inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Corylus Avellana Seed Oil, Capsicum Frutescens Fruit Extract, Potassium Hydroxide, Ethylhexylglycerin, Phenoxyethanol, Caffeine, Carbomer, Vitis Vinifera Seed Oil, Parfum, Persea Gratissima Oil.
directions: Apply to clean and dry skin. After applying a thin layer to the skin, massage in circular motions. It is recommended to use it twice a day.
purpose_from_pack: With its botanical ingredients and caffeine, it supports skin firming. It helps to maintain the skin's moisture balance without drying it out.
warnings: For external use only. Store in a dry, sunless place at room temperature. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes; in case of contact, rinse thoroughly with plenty of water.
label_company_on_pack: L B İÇ VE DIŞ TİCARET KOZMETİK A.Ş. (İstanbul, Kadıköy)
